successor.name: Frigidaire Gallery French Door Series
successor.why: It continues Frigidaire's core mid-tier multi-door lineup with similar feature sets.
successor.differences: Updated internal shelving and slightly refined exterior styling.
successor.concern: Ice maker reliability has been a historical pain point in this line.

suggestions.name: Whirlpool French Door Series
suggestions.why: Matches the capacity, French door layout, and external water dispenser.
suggestions.differences: Different internal bin layout and cooling system design.

suggestions.name: LG French Door Series
suggestions.why: Offers comparable large capacity and standard 36-inch width with water dispensing.
suggestions.differences: Uses dual evaporator cooling and linear compressor technology.
suggestions.concern: Linear compressors have had long-term reliability concerns.
